# Benchmark allocation baseline for the CI gate in .github/workflows/bench-gate.yml.
#
# Format (one benchmark per line, whitespace-separated):
#   <package> <BenchmarkName> <B/op> <allocs/op>
# <package> is module-relative: core/... for the core module, service/sync/...
# for the sync service. ns/op is deliberately NOT recorded: it is not
# reproducible on shared runners (see the workflow header for the rationale).
#
# Values: minimum B/op (and its allocs/op) over -count=3 -benchtime=1s,
# -benchmem, measured with the recipe documented in bench-gate.yml on the
# audit branch (bugfix/audit-2026-10-19) on 2026-10-20, Go toolchain pinned
# by core/go.mod (go1.27.2; service/sync measured under its go 1.26.9
# directive). B/op and allocs/op are exact allocator counters, so the
# machine these were captured on does not matter.
#
# Update procedure: bench-gate.yml header, "HOW TO UPDATE THE BASELINE".
# Never hand-edit numbers you did not measure.
